When you learn about us, you find a team dedicated to providing exceptional carpet cleaning, air duct cleaning, and upholstery cleaning services. When clients ask about us, we share that every technician is certified and trained to handle any cleaning challenge. We serve Irvine, Anaheim, Santa Ana, Newport Beach, and all of Orange County.

A Cleaner, Healthier Home Starts with Us

At Carpet & Duct Cleaning , we believe a truly clean space is one that not only looks great—but feels healthier, smells fresher, and supports your well-being. Since 2021, we’ve proudly served Irvine and the greater Orange County area , offering expert carpet, upholstery, air duct, and dryer vent cleaning services for homes and businesses alike. Backed by over a decade of combined industry experience , our certified team is committed to raising the standard of clean with eco-friendly methods, cutting-edge equipment, and meticulous attention to detail.

Our Mission

h6

Breathe Better. Live Better.

We're on a mission to transform everyday living environments into healthier, more comfortable spaces. From deep-cleaned carpets to air ducts free of dust and allergens , our goal is simple: to help you breathe easier and feel better in the spaces you call home or work. Whether it’s a one-bedroom condo or a multi-floor commercial office, our approach stays the same— safe, effective, and done right the first time .

From Local Roots to County-Wide Trust

What began as a small operation in Irvine, CA , has quickly grown into a name trusted across Orange County—from Anaheim and Tustin to Huntington Beach, Costa Mesa, Laguna Niguel, and Yorba Linda . We launched our company out of a passion for solving a common but often ignored issue—poor indoor air quality. Over time, we’ve seen firsthand how professional cleaning can reduce allergens, boost HVAC efficiency, and even uplift people’s daily lives . Each successful job has strengthened our commitment to providing not just clean spaces—but cleaner lifestyles. We're on a mission to transform everyday living environments into healthier, more comfortable spaces. From deep-cleaned carpets to air ducts free of dust and allergens , our goal is simple: to help you breathe easier and feel better in the spaces you call home or work. Whether it’s a one-bedroom condo or a multi-floor commercial office, our approach stays the same— safe, effective, and done right the first time .

Why Clients Choose Us

We're proud to be the go-to cleaning service for hundreds of families and businesses across Orange County. Here’s what sets us apart:

Over 10 Years of Combined Experience

100% Satisfaction Guaranteed

Flexible Scheduling, Emergency Availability

Green Cleaning Products – No Harsh Chemicals

Top-Tier Equipment & Advanced Cleaning Techniques

Meet the Team Behind the Clean

div

We’re not just technicians—we’re trained professionals who care. Every member of our team is certified, highly skilled, and passionate about delivering a spotless result. Whether it’s restoring a water-damaged carpet or cleaning a commercial HVAC system, we bring the same level of detail and dedication. We don’t just clean—we care.

We treat every space like it’s our own, and every client like a family. If you’re ready to experience a fresher, safer, and healthier home , we’re ready to help.
